note: Chance Me judges GPA against a school's level, normally its acceptance rate nudged by its SAT range. These schools' acceptance rates understate how competitive their applicants are (UC applicants apply to several UCs at once, and these test-blind schools have no SAT range to correct it), so Chance Me treats them as if they admitted this share instead. Affects only the GPA comparison; the odds still start from the school's real acceptance rate.
